scientific.integrity: The infinite-mean statement is proved from the nonsingular Gaussian density and a reciprocal singularity when one gradient coordinate approaches zero. The two-dimensional floor follows from an exact singular-value identity for one-sided diagonal row scaling.
limitations: The object is the unregularized instantaneous condition-number diagnostic, not full Adam or Adam-mini dynamics.
A positive denominator regularizer removes the literal infinite-mean singularity.
The exact deterministic lower envelope is proved only for two dimensions.
The result concerns spectral conditioning, not convergence rates or training loss.

title: Infinite-mean Adam conditioning under Gaussian initialization, with a sharp two-dimensional floor
